steps.content: Ladies and gentlemen...
Welcome to Fortuna Theater!

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: I am the manager of the theater, and you may call me Lady Pearl.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Hehe! Don't be frightened, my dear! Tuck away those wary eyes!

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Since you're here at my theater, I bet you all... are longing to enjoy a musical like no other, right?

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Have no worries, Fortuna, will leave no room for disappointment!
Lady Pearl gracefully positions herself at the microphone. Her arms open wide, she smiles, engaging the crowd with her warmth.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Don't hold back, and don't fear! Keep your sense of wonder and admiration alive!

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: In here, please unleash your imagination. Whatever you desire to witness, whoever you dream to become, it's all within reach.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: So, dear guests, let's cast aside the outside world. Turn your full attention to the marvels of this theater, reflect on the performances.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Oh! Almost forgot!
As she prepares to exit, Lady Pearl, with a sudden spark of whimsy, playfully winks at you in the crowd.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Perhaps, you guys will be able to find your destined roles here, embark on a unique life journey, and stage an unprecedented drama just for me.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Here in Fortuna, that's more than possible. I'm thrilled to welcome you all to join in this one-of-a-kind musical extravaganza!
Suddenly, the lights go out, thrusting everyone back into darkness. The audience can't help but buzz with conversation, uneasily pondering the theater owner's speech.
In their preoccupation, they all fail to notice the subtle rustling noise starting to echo around them.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Hmm?!
Once your eyes adapt to the lighting, you see that the splendid stage in front of you has changed. Right now, it's enveloped by black bars that came out of nowhere, becoming a massive cage.

Inside the massive cage, there are separate smaller cages, each with a performer—some are caught in heated arguments, others burst into crazed, silly laughter. You notice that all the audience members, yourself included, are also enclosed by the bars.
Furthermore, the Sinners who were right next to you a moment ago have been dispersed. It's unclear which of these numerous cages they've ended up in.
Looking at this scene, you can't help but have mixed feelings.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Are we... really a part of this play?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Intriguing, I'm usually the one locking people up.

steps.content: Wait, that's not 100% true. You suddenly remember—you've been locked up before too.
No... this isn't making sense. What's going on here...
How did everyone disappear all of a sudden?
Luvia was just here by my side, and suddenly, she's disappeared, and so has ${PlayerName}... where could they have gone...
Nearby, a panicked but familiar voice cuts through your thoughts, offering a brief respite of calm.
Glancing up, you notice the red-haired Sinner biting her lip, anxiously clinging to the bars, looking all around—obviously distressed about being a "part of this play."

steps.speaker: Prisoner A
steps.content: Hey, looks like the newcomer can't handle the pressure, huh?

steps.speaker: Prisoner B
steps.content: That's right, girl, better calm down a bit, or you'll end up bringing the guards down on us!

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: The guards? Could they... help me find my friends?

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: My friends, one wearing grey, and another, a very beautiful girl! They've... they've all disappeared... I need to find them...

steps.speaker: Prisoner A
steps.content: Believe me, you wouldn't want to talk to the guards.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: What does that mean...?

steps.speaker: Prisoner B
steps.content: Regarding them...
The prisoner pushes her face through the bars, frantically signaling Ignis to lean in, seemingly doesn't want their remarks to be overheard by "the guards"...

steps.speaker: Prisoner B
steps.content: Those devils, they're the kind who'd swallow a person whole without a second thought...

steps.speaker: Prisoner B
steps.content: If you're skeptical... just wait and see! Hahahaha!
The prisoner's laughter is quickly drowned out by the darkness, then a startling blue light flares up. Right then, you hear a shrill whistle—
Black Screen
